Purple blotch.summary: Purple blotch is an important foliar disease of onion that can damage leaves and reduce crop performance.
symptoms: Purple to brown lesions or blotches on onion leaves
Lesions may enlarge as disease progresses
Severe infection can lead to drying and weakening of foliage
recommended_actions: Inspect nearby onion plants for similar symptoms
Remove severely affected plant material where practical
Avoid conditions that keep foliage unnecessarily wet
Use locally recommended integrated disease-management practices
Consult an agricultural officer before applying crop-protection chemicals
Purple blotch.source_name: ICAR - Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research

stemphylium Leaf Blight.summary: Stemphylium leaf blight is a foliar disease of onion that affects leaf tissue and can contribute to foliage deterioration.
symptoms: Affected leaf tissue may progressively dry
Severe disease can reduce healthy green leaf area
recommended_actions: Monitor the field for spread of foliar symptoms
Remove severely affected material where practical
Reduce prolonged leaf wetness where crop management allows
Follow locally recommended integrated disease-management practices
Seek agricultural officer guidance before chemical treatment
stemphylium Leaf Blight.source_name: ICAR - Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research

Fusarium-D.summary: The AI class indicates symptoms associated with the model's Fusarium disease category. Field confirmation is required before treatment decisions.
symptoms: Possible yellowing or decline of affected plants
Possible deterioration around roots or basal plant tissue
Symptoms should be confirmed by an agricultural officer
recommended_actions: Inspect the base and roots of affected plants
Avoid excessive soil moisture and poor drainage
Separate severely affected plants where appropriate
Request field verification before applying disease-control chemicals
Fusarium-D.source_name: FasalRakshak provisional knowledge entry - requires onion-specific authoritative source verification

Caterpillar-P.summary: The AI class indicates possible caterpillar-related feeding damage. The pest species must be confirmed before treatment.
symptoms: Possible chewing or feeding damage on foliage
Damaged leaf tissue may be visible
Larvae or other pest evidence may be present near affected plants
recommended_actions: Inspect plants for larvae and feeding damage
Check nearby plants to estimate how widely the problem has spread
Use integrated pest-management practices appropriate to the identified pest
Consult an agricultural officer before pesticide application
Caterpillar-P.source_name: FasalRakshak provisional knowledge entry - requires pest-specific authoritative source verification
